Name: Jump Down The Mine Redux
Author: jns0fficial
Description:
Since the original mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8357]here[/url] is no longer updated, I decided to make a similar mod of my own.

This mod allows players to skip levels in the Skull Cavern by simply pressing a button:

[list]
[*]Press [b]Numpad 1[/b]: jump down [b]1 level﻿[/b]
[*]Press [b]Numpad 2[/b]: jump down [b]5 level﻿s[/b]
[*]Press [b]Numpad 3[/b]: jump down [b]10 level﻿s[/b]
[*]Press [b]Numpad 4[/b]: jump down [b]100 level﻿s[/b]
[*]Press [b]Numpad 5[/b]: jump down [b]1000 level﻿s[/b]
[/list]
It's as simple as that! This mod is save game compatible and can be installed any time, as long as you are running SV 1.6+ and have the latest version of SMAPI.

Why numpad keys? Honestly I'm playing with a bunch of mods myself and there were not many keys left that were available to use; so I decided to use numpad keys for the input. Maybe in the future I'll change this or make it configurable via the general mod manager.

Plans for the future:
[list]
[*]Make input keys configurable
[*]Add support for the base cave and other mines
[/list]
